summary.finding: A quadratic phase (short ~n^2/2-gate circuit) resists MPS compression almost as much as fully random phases -> a short quantum circuit can express a turbulence-like field that classical tensor networks cannot compress.
summary.honest_limits: Representability is NOT an application advantage. Real turbulence phases are not exactly quadratic (coherent vortices may compress better). Evolving Navier-Stokes and reading out useful observables efficiently are open problems (Carleman / Childs et al. lower bounds). 1D only.
